about:
Strategy Plastics operates a 40,000-square-foot facility in Williamston, South Carolina, roughly 25 miles from the Greenville-Spartanburg Airport. The company was acquired in June 2013 and has doubled in size since then, growing into a full-service injection molding operation.

The shop runs 17 injection molding machines ranging from 35 to 720 tons of clamping force, supporting both single-shot and multi-shot processes. Beyond molding, the firm offers custom molding, engineering, project management, parts assembly, testing, dimensional analysis, and tooling procurement from domestic and offshore sources.

It serves the automotive, appliance, and consumer-goods industries, providing molded parts for various applications in those markets.

The company attributes its expansion to a focus on customer needs and solution-oriented service, underpinned by an ISO 9001:2015 certification issued by Intertek, and a commitment to quality and customer service across all industries served.
